name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The list of tag keys to delete. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. If you leave this parameter empty, you can use the All parameter to delete all tags
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的标签键列表，不超过20个。不填可通过All参数删除所有标签
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en: The PID or instance ID of the application. You can specify up to 50 IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the ARMS resource whose tags you want to modify. Valid values: 

WEB: Browser Monitoring 
APPLICATION: Application Monitoring 
PROMETHEUS: Managed Service for Prometheus 
SYNTHETICTASK: Synthetic Monitoring 
ALERTRULE: Application Monitoring alert 
PROMETHEUSALERTRULE: Managed Service for Prometheus alert
XTRACEAPP: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry application
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改标签的ARMS资源类型。 

WEB-前端监控 
APPLICATION-应用监控 
PROMETHEUS-可观测监控 Prometheus 版 
SYNTHETICTASK-云拨测 
ALERTRULE-应用监控告警 
PROMETHEUSALERTRULE-可观测监控 Prometheus 版告警
XTRACEAPP - 可观测链路 OpenTelemetry 版应用
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete all tags. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is empty. Valid values:

true: Deletes all tags.
false (default): Does not delete all tags
parameters.help_zh:
是否全部删除，只针对TagKey.N为空时有效。取值范围：

true：全部删除
false（默认）：不全部删除
parameters.name: all

fields.help_en: The tag key. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。必填参数，不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或 `https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the instance.

If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签值。

如果传入该值，则允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag key-value pairs. This parameter is required if you do not specify the ResourceIds parameter. The following describes the valid values:                              

key: the tag key. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.                                 
value: the tag value. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length. 
                                
Tag keys and values are case-sensitive. If you specify multiple tags, all the tags are created and attached to the specified resource at the same time. Each tag key on the same resource can correspond to only one tag value. If you attempt to add an existing tag key, the corresponding tag value is updated to the new value. The tag key and value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
标签键值对，当您未输入ResourceIds参数时必填。取值说明如下：                              

key：标签键，字符长度范围[1,128]。                                 
value：标签值，字符长度范围[1,128]。 
                                
区分大小写。如果指定多个标签，则会为指定资源同时创建并绑定多个标签。同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值。不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tags

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the deletion was successful
